summary_en: The video documents two chefs preparing and cooking crispy fried fish salad in a kitchen setting. It begins by displaying fresh ingredients, shredding vegetables, and seasoning the fish. Next, the chef deep-fries the fish in hot oil and prepares the sauce. Finally, the dish is assembled with shredded vegetables, topped with crispy fish, drizzled with sauce, garnished with peanuts and herbs, and presented to the viewers.
